chunks: Only they are turned away thus who deny the signs of God.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that are turned away from the truth according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the cognitive distortion of the disbelievers, where their rejection of divine signs (ayat) leads to 'yufaak'—being turned away from the truth by their own fabricated falsehoods. This reflects the principle that persistent denial of clear evidence results in a self-imposed spiritual blindness, a theme central to the narrative of the Children of Israel in Surah Ghafir. The verse serves as a warning that kufr is not merely a lack of belief but an active diversion from reality.
